{{Quote|This is ''my'' crew. They are loyal to the throne&mdash;''and'' me. They will not take orders from ''renegades''.|Vaclen Tor|<ref name="Legacy 36" />}}
'''Vaclen Tor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], who served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We swore oaths of duty to the throne and that throne is on Coruscant. We pledged our lives and our honor to this duty!|Vaclen Tor|<ref name="Legacy 36" />}}
In [[137 ABY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] Vaclen Tor was in command of the [[Ardent-class fast frigate|''Ardent''-class fast frigate]] [[Steadfast (Ardent-class)|''Steadfast'']]. Assigned to the [[Coruscant Third Fleet]], ''Steadfast'' was tasked with protecting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], when the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] and the [[Empire-in-exile]] launched a surprise [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|attack]] on the planet, intending to seize as many Imperial ships as possible.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

When fleet's commander, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Peto Kelsan]], agreed to the ultimatum of Admiral [[Edouard Fenel]] and ordered the overwhelmed fleet to surrender. However, Vaclen Tor refused to do so, reminding Kelsan of their duty to self-destruct the fleet. Admiral Fenel retaliated by authorizing Tor's crew to rise up in mutiny against him. The captain counteracted by reiterating that his crew were loyal to him and the Imperial throne, adding that they would not obey orders from renegades.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

Furious at this act of defiance, Fenel ordered all his ships, including Kelsan's vessels, to fire on the ''Steadfast'', but Tor made a clever move and managed to position one of Ralltiir's moons between his ship and Fenel's fleet. Motivated by Tor, Kelsan ordered the fleet to set their ships for self-destruct and then leave in the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. Kelsan chose to stay on the ''Avenger'' as it self-destructed.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

However, ''Steadfast'' took some damage and its lifepods were offline, as was the self-destruct mechanism. Admiral [[Gar Stazi]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] decided to deposit both Vaclen Tor and his crew to the surface of Ralltiir and then send the ship to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] as a gift. This effectively denied Fenel custody of Tor and his crew while affirming that the Alliance were allies but not Fel's vassals.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

By [[138 ABY]], Captain Tor remained within the Sith Empire's Navy. He was present during the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|Sith Imperial assault]] against the [[Hidden Temple]] of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] on [[Taivas]], in command of the [[Intruder (Ardent-class)|''Intruder'']]. During the space battle against the combined forces of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant|Galactic Alliance]] [[Core Fleet|fleet]] and Fel loyalist vessels, the ''Intruder'' sustained severe damage and was destroyed.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|That frigate captain's a good man&mdash;''"<br />"''Yes, but fighting for a bad cause.|Captain [[Jhoram Bey]] and Admiral Gar Stazi|<ref name="Legacy 36" />}}
As a competent military officer, Captain Vaclen Tor remained true to his duty in the face of great adversity. Tor remained loyal to the Imperial throne itself. Thus, he also rejected any moves towards compromising or submitting to his government's foes&mdash;the [[Empire-in-exile|Bastion resistance]] and the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]].<ref name="Legacy 36" />

When his superior officer Admiral Peto Kelsan ordered the fleet to surrender following a coordinated Alliance-Fel Empire attack, Tor maintained his allegiance to the throne by disregarding the former's orders as contrary to Imperial code, which he cited. Realizing that the Alliance and Fel's Empire intended to seize the vessels of the Coruscant Third Fleet intact, he ordered his crew to activate self-destruct devices and to bail out over Ralltiir, thus denying his enemy their objective. This brave tactic won the respect of both Kelsan as well as his Alliance adversaries Admiral Stazi and Captain Bey, who proceeded to support him when Fenel ordered the destruction of all life-pods from the Coruscant Third Fleet.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vaclen Tor was introduced in the [[Legacy (2006) 36|thirty-sixth]] issue of ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', ''Renegade'', published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. Created by series writer [[John Ostrander]] for the issue, the character of Vaclen Tor was drawn by [[Omar Francia]]. Kelsan was colored by [[Brad Anderson]].<ref name="Legacy 36" />
